name: Randy Brooks

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Randy Brooks is a haiku and tanka poet, editor and teacher associated with Millikin University in Illinois. With Shirley Brooks, he publishes Brooks Books and co-edits Mayfly, a magazine of English-language haiku. His books include Walking the Fence: Selected Tanka and The Art of Reading and Writing Haiku, which brings student poems and readers’ responses into conversation.

His Kabita Live sequences find humour and tenderness in precise encounters: a shared umbrella, apples labelled for friends, a kayak touching river rock. In “Hold On” and “Floating World”, moss, small animals and the body’s changing viewpoint invite close attention. The brief poems leave space for readers to make connections without explaining each image.
